bayts.text: In the Name of God: spare me all turbidity, O Allah; through it make pure for me abiding in You, O Allah.
O He to Whom the Command belongs, O He Who has no partner: expand, make master and set (me) free in You, O Allah.
I have turned to You today, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), hoping for my success in what I have willed in Your world, O Allah.
You are the Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), by Whose mercy I hope to meet no harm from You, O Allah.
Make my right hand and my heart masters of what I ask, O my King (Al-Malik), without reckoning, by generosity from You, O Allah.
You have sanctified my secret, O Most Holy (Al-Quddūs), well pleased with me; and with You I am well pleased forever, O Allah.
You are the Peace (As-Salām), Who have kept my whole being safe from the faults of my soul, folding them (away) from You, O Allah.
O Giver of faith (Al-Muʾmin), spare my person harm and turbidity, and grant me safety in the two Abodes, O Allah.
And as Guardian (Al-Muhaymin) bear witness for me to Your purchase of what I sold in secret, (in exchange) for the Gardens (Qurʾān 9:111), O Allah.
You are the Mighty (Al-ʿAzīz), by Whose might I seek a might that makes honour everlasting for me: Allah!
You have compelled for me — You are the Compeller (Al-Jabbār) — without encounter, all the enemies, by what You chose for me, O Allah.
You have spared me every proud one, without toil; O Supreme in Greatness (Al-Mutakabbir), You have tamed them all, O Allah.
O Creator (Al-Khāliq) of creation, create for me what I wish, forever, with gladness, purity and good pleasure, O Allah.
O Maker (Al-Bāriʾ) of creation, lead benefit to me without harm, and lead to me the reward for the Gardens, O Allah.
You are the Fashioner (Al-Muṣawwir): make glad tidings everlasting for the Prophet, and fashion (good) for me without guile, O Allah.
You have forgiven me every sin I committed: bear witness for me to my gratitude, O Forgiver (Al-Ghaffār), O Allah.
You have subdued my enemies for me, Lord, without cause on my part: I have praised You, O Subduer (Al-Qahhār), O Allah.
You have given me from Yourself a request (granted) that surpassed my asking: so to You is my gratitude, O Bestower (Al-Wahhāb), O Allah.
You have led to me the prices (the rewards) of the deep sea, O He to Whom my life (belongs), and You have led sustenance to me, O Provider (Ar-Razzāq), O Allah.
You have opened for me every door You had opened for Your saints, O Opener (Al-Fattāḥ), O Allah.
You have taught me the unseen until I became awakened: You are the All-Knowing (Al-ʿAlīm) Who have taught, O Allah.
You have withheld, O Withholder (Al-Qābiḍ), the evils, and they turned toward another direction than mine, like the turbid things, O Allah.
You have expanded, O Expander (Al-Bāsiṭ), hopes for me with good pleasure: so accept my intimacy in the two Abodes, O Allah.
You have abased, O Abaser (Al-Khāfiḍ), the enemies for me, and they went off toward another direction than mine, by an abasing from You, O Allah.
You have raised, O Exalter (Ar-Rāfiʿ), my rank in the two Abodes, without abasement, by grace from You, O Allah.
You are the Bestower of honour (Al-Muʿizz), to Whose might I have clung, (I) an honoured friend and beloved in You, O Allah.
You are the Humiliator (Al-Mudhill), before Whose might mankind, the jinn and Satan have been humbled, O Allah.
You are the All-Hearing (As-Samīʿ), with Whom I have conversed intimately for a long time, and with joys You have been lavish to me, O Allah.
You are the All-Seeing (Al-Baṣīr), Who has led to me all that You chose for me, in this world and the next, from You, O Allah.
You have decreed, O Everlasting Judge (Al-Ḥakam), that I be a possessor of success, through what is hidden of Your glad tidings, O Allah.
You have dragged away, O Just (Al-ʿAdl), my enemies, without encounter or harm, and You have been for me, O Allah.
You are the Subtle (Al-Laṭīf), Who have led to me forever a wondrous subtle kindness that increases reflection, O Allah.
You are the All-Aware (Al-Khabīr), Whose knowledge I have seen with my eyes, and You have led to me from You the knowledge of the unseen, O Allah.
You are the Forbearing (Al-Ḥalīm), Who have removed all those You did not approve for me, toward others, forever, O Allah.
You are the Magnificent (Al-ʿAẓīm), Whose greatness has appeared; You have led to me an immense favour from You, O Allah.
You are the All-Forgiving (Al-Ghafūr), Who have led to me a forgiveness that effaced my faults: I am well pleased with You, O Allah.
You are the Appreciative (Ash-Shakūr), with Whom my whole being is good pleasure, and for me You have appreciated all the striving, O Allah.
You are the Most High (Al-ʿAlī), Who have raised me forever without guile, and for me You have made (good) lawful, O Allah.
You are the Great (Al-Kabīr), Whose greatness has appeared; You have led to me from You a great reward, O Allah.
You are the Preserver (Al-Ḥafīẓ), Who have turned forever toward others than me the enemies and harm, O Allah.
You are the Sustainer (Al-Muqīt), Who have made ease everlasting for me, without reckoning, until the Gardens, O Allah.
You are the Sufficient Reckoner (Al-Ḥasīb), with Whom I have been content, (sheltered) from enemies, harm and toil, O Allah.
You are the Majestic (Al-Jalīl), Whose majesty has driven the enemies toward others than us, in the two Abodes, O Allah.
You are the Generous (Al-Karīm), Who have led generosity to me in this world and the next, with glad tidings, O Allah.
You are the Watchful (Ar-Raqīb), Whose guarding of my whole being, from all that is not good pleasure, has appeared, O Allah.
You are the Responsive (Al-Mujīb), through Whom without toil an answer from You has yielded (to me), for me, in what You chose for me, O Allah.
And truly You are the All-Embracing (Al-Wāsiʿ), the Everlasting, and for me, forever, You have widened a breadth with emancipation (from the Fire), O Allah.
You are the Wise (Al-Ḥakīm), Who have made me fit for other than what grieved me, and You have effaced the evil, O Allah.
You are the Loving (Al-Wadūd), Whose love has yielded to me forever with good pleasure and nearness, O Allah.
You are the Glorious (Al-Majīd), Whose glory has appeared, and You have led to me from You a glory that surpasses (all), O Allah.
And truly You are the Resurrector (Al-Bāʿith), Who makes endure without harm: You have spared me all turbidity, O Allah.
You are the Witness (Ash-Shahīd), Whose testimony has yielded to me of Your purchase from me of that (which I sold), O Allah.
O Truth (Al-Ḥaqq), bear witness for me with truth, and efface all that You have not approved for me, absolutely, by grace, O Allah.
You are the Trustee (Al-Wakīl), with Whom I have been content in warding off (evil) and drawing (good), O Lord of creation, O Allah.
